response.justification: Bogdan possesses an exceptionally strong technical background with over 15 years of software engineering experience, including significant work in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and mobile platforms. However, the resume lacks any indication of formal people management or direct team leadership experience, which is a strict minimum requirement for this mid-to-senior Level II Engineering Manager position focused on full-time people leadership.
strengths: Extensive experience building developer tools, testing frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure at Altom Consulting and through open-source projects.
Solid exposure to mobile platform ecosystems, including hands-on iOS development and mobile device orchestration tooling.
Demonstrated technical leadership as a Staff Engineer and through organizing coding dojos, workshops, and open-source initiatives.
concerns: Zero documented experience in formal people management, conducting 1-on-1s, or performance evaluations.
Lacks the required 2+ years of direct team leadership necessary for a mid-to-senior management role.
No explicitly mentioned experience leading organizational change or setting broader organizational goals.
